body: 为里斯本做2:3彩色夏日矢量风旅行海报。顶部准确写 LISBON，下方小字 PORTUGAL。黄色电车、斜坡街道、红瓦屋顶、蓝色河面，珊瑚、天蓝、暖黄配色。严格使用少量大型几何纯色色块、硬边路径和均匀平涂；极简丝网印刷图形，不使用笔触、纸纹、颗粒、照片细节、渐变或写实光影。仅两行文字。

en.title: Lisbon vector-style travel poster
en.description: LISBON and PORTUGAL are spelled correctly, with a yellow tram, sloped street, red roofs and blue river in simplified flat shapes. Some subtle tonal variation remains.

## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

LISBON and PORTUGAL are spelled correctly, with a yellow tram, sloped street, red roofs and blue river in simplified flat shapes. Some subtle tonal variation remains.
